issuer: the Idaho Transportation Department, Division of Motor Vehicles
note: ITD's licence page (read 2026-10-30) gives the operator (Class D) 8-year licence, ages 21 to 62, at $60.00 (4 years, 21 and over, $35.00; younger drivers get 1- and 3-year licences); the 8-year licence is kept, from 21, the youngest age it is issued at, which is the age a licence on these terms is held from (an under-21 licence is a shorter one, not held). The ID card page gives an 8-year card, 21 and over, at $25.00. No youngest age for the card was read (cards are sold under 18).

sources.title: Idaho DMV, Driver's Licenses & ID Cards
sources.said: 8-Year License (age 21 to 62) $60.00 ... A standard (Class D) driver’s license renewal is valid for either four years or eight years.
